entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if everyone else is locked up in[n]here, just like how I was...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, I can wait here. Why don't you go[n]save everyone else too?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It doesn't seem like there are any[n]Shadows around, so I think I should[n]be fine on my own.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm sure they're all waiting to see you...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They're here, I'm sure of it! I mean, if[n]the two of us were locked up, I know[n]they are too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, I'm not the only one in here, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Please go save everyone else.[n]It's something only you can do...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Please go save everyone. They have to[n]be somewhere around here...
